test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A shopkeeper sells 35 kg sugar for every 40 kg using false weights. How much percentage profit does he make if sells sugar at cost price (rounded off to two places of decimal)?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Let the CP of 40 kg of sugar = Rs. 40

CP of 35 kg of sugar = Rs. 35

If sells sugar at cost price,

SP of 35 kg of sugar = Rs. 40 (false weight)

Profit = SP - CP

⇒ 40 - 35 = 5

Profit % = [Profit/CP] × 100

⇒ [5/35 × 100]

⇒ 14.28%

**Percentage profit is 14.28%**

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
